title: The Love-Matic Grampa
description: Moe the bartender discovers his love testing machine has been taken over by the ghost of Abe Simpson, who is here to help him with his romantic problems.
quote: Hey, I don’t need no advice from no pinball machine.
creator: Matt Groening
altHero: Moe pointing and smiling at a light-up love testing machine
alt1: Moe cleaning the bar looking sad
alt2: Moe thinking next to the love machine
alt3: Moe smiling at a woman using the machine
alt4: Moe and the woman holding hands in front of the machine
